svg.title: Osama Anwar - three dimensional terminal profile header
svg.desc: A dark 3D scene: a perspective grid receding to the horizon, a rotating wireframe icosahedron, and the name Osama Anwar in extruded type above the roles Software Engineer, Quality Engineering, and Camera and Image Quality. Status online, based in Pakistan, 32 public repositories.
